newsitem.title: UK: Cirqual buys Wollaston Eng for 11 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Cirqual buys Wollaston Eng for 11 mln stg.

text.p: Cirqual Plc said on Friday it had agreed to buy Wollaston, a specialist engineering business involved in the design and manufacture of components for the automotive, aerospace and electronics industries, for a maximum of 11.0 million stg.

"The directors of Cirqual consider that Wollaston will be a valuable additon...(it) is a fast growing, profitable and cash generative business which fits Cirqual's acquisition criteria," Cirqual said in a statement.
Engineering group Cirqual manufactures aluminium and thermoplastic products.
